directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Main-unit weight is is 2300 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。理论输送量是21 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger: Outrigger. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Output Capacity is 21 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. Main-unit weight is is 2300 kg. Subject: VOLVO L60H Articulated loader. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger页上的Outrigger。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动40型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。外形尺寸是3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 2300 kg. The frame “Loader (equipment)” shows VOLVO L60H Articulated loader and is not a site measurement of this model. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Output Capacity. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 理论输送量是21 m³/h，最大出口压力是23 MPa。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。细石输送（水平/垂直） 120 m / 360 m。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. The shown output stays 21 m³/h. Fine Stone Pumping (H / V) 120 m / 360 m.
body.zh: 画面「Loader (equipment)」的主体是VOLVO L60H Articulated 装载机，不是这个型号的工地实测。主体：VOLVO L60H Articulated 装载机。

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 21 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outrigger.
